number.why: HR 1.54 (0.94-2.53) is PHILO major bleeding (primary safety endpoint), ticagrelor vs clopidogrel, 12 months. It is not major-or-minor bleeding 1.72 or the efficacy composite 1.47. The registry confirms it in the safety analysis set.

quotes.span: overall major bleeding occurred in 10.3% of ticagrelor-treated patients and in 6.8% of clopidogrel-treated patients (hazard ratio (HR), 1.54; 95% confidence interval (CI): 0.94-2.53)

entry.why: Patients (minimum age 20) with NSTE or STE ACS, randomised to ticagrelor vs clopidogrel; this falls within adults with ACS.

quotes.span: Index event of non-ST or ST segment elevation ACS

missed: served_outcome.estimand is RR while an HR is served; the ruling notes this. Unlike M-02, no counts are printed to derive an RR. The abstract's rates (10.3% vs 6.8%) differ from the registry's KM rates (11.2 vs 8.4); only the HR is safe to use. The population is restricted to East Asian patients.
